desc: This silver statuette of a raven can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmRaven000000000]{Raven} for up to 12 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed. While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAnimalMess]{Animal Messenger} on it.
This item's limited uses represent the 2 days required before the figurine can be used again.
name: silver raven
